decision_basis: Successful 100-update constant-shape H100 pilot; observed first trial update-loop wall time about 95 seconds. Main budget fixed uniformly before any main outcomes; no ratio selected by pilot performance.

pre_execution_gate.action_if_unmet: abort and preserve records; do not adapt any condition budget

complete_pilot_timing_memory_receipts: Read and SHA-exported by cloud_main before any main updates. Full local readback pending at freeze time; no exact peak-memory claim yet.
expected_duration: About 9-12 GPU hours inferred from pilot throughput and full55 evaluation duration; not a guarantee or billed usage.
limits: Three continuation seeds share one pretrained parent.
Uniform starts do not imply uniform effective gradient mass because of native done masks.
Original gate counts are not strict physical-quality certification.
